cohort: 14 neonates in the neonatal intensive care unit with pneumothorax, born to mothers positive for SARS-CoV-2 immunoglobulin M and immunoglobulin G
finding: Infants of pregnant women with symptomatic or asymptomatic COVID-19 may develop respiratory distress and pneumothorax.
mod_finding: One male infant was born by normal spontaneous vaginal delivery, while all other infants were born by C-section.
